description: This file defines the implementation of the LoanJournalEntryPoster interface, responsible for posting journal entries related to loan transactions and external owner transfers. It primarily acts as a wrapper around the JournalEntryWritePlatformService, invoking methods to create journal entries for specific loan events.

classes.name: LoanJournalEntryPosterImpl
classes.description: Implementation of LoanJournalEntryPoster; handles posting of journal entries related to loan transactions and external owner transfers.

methods.name: postJournalEntriesForLoanTransaction
methods.description: Posts journal entries for a given loan transaction, handling different transfer scenarios.

methods.name: postJournalEntriesForExternalOwnerTransfer
methods.description: Posts journal entries for an external asset owner transfer associated with a specific loan.
